output.brief: The rise is most likely normal week-to-week variation, not a fault from v4.18. The week of 26 Oct was 0.41%, below the 0.48% upper edge of the normal band from the past 26 weeks, and the burn rate (0.82x) did not trigger the page. The apparent release effect comes from new pods starting with a cold quote cache, which causes timeouts on every rollout, including a config-only redeploy with no code change. Booking completion was flat (41.0% to 41.2%). I'm fairly confident about the band result and the warm-up explanation, but I have not checked the read-replica move or the partner-sync month-end run. Recommended: do not roll back v4.18, do not mute alerting, and record the week as within normal at ops review. Keep the burn-rate page on. Check the next week as normal. If the rate exceeds the band, or the burn-rate page fires, open an investigation then, and check the replica host change and partner-sync timing at that point.
